tool_plan.objective: Generate and preserve representative Chromium HTTP cache content for ChromeCacheView to list, inspect, export, and extract.

required_actions.name: browser.launch
required_actions.why: Creates a Chromium session and profile that can generate Chrome cache data.

required_actions.name: browser.goto
required_actions.why: Loads distinct documents and resources that create cache entries and URL metadata.

required_actions.name: browser.get_clickables
required_actions.why: Observes visible controls and finite choices before exercising cache-producing page behavior.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_type
required_actions.why: Supplies realistic search or form input that can produce distinct cached responses.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_click
required_actions.why: Exercises contextually relevant links or controls that load additional cached content.

required_actions.name: browser.click
required_actions.why: Commits observed controls when a specific visible page action is needed.

required_actions.name: browser.select_option
required_actions.why: Varies observed finite parameters that can request materially different cached resources.

required_actions.name: browser.scroll
required_actions.why: Reveals lazy-loaded or progressive content that can add cached resources.

required_actions.name: browser.close
required_actions.why: Closes the browser after activity so pending cache writes can be finalized before collection.

completion.detail: Complete after Chromium has been closed and chromium.cache.cache_data is present for collection by ChromeCacheView.

tool_plan.action_intent_guidance: Action Flow: Launch Chromium and use run-provided runtime resources with browser.goto to load a few relevant, resource-rich pages that naturally request documents, images, scripts, and other HTTP responses. On each page, use browser.get_clickables before interaction; use browser.smart_type for visible search or form fields, browser.smart_click or browser.click for observed content-loading controls and links, and browser.select_option for visible finite choices that request different page content. Use browser.scroll to reveal progressive or lazy-loaded resources, then re-run browser.get_clickables and perform a bounded observe -> reveal -> re-observe loop where newly visible controls are relevant. Navigate among distinct available runtime targets where appropriate. These visits and visible interactions should populate Chromium HTTP cache entries and associated URL metadata. Finish with browser.close to finalize pending cache writes. Reason guidance: state the current page/context and cache effect, such as that an image-heavy page was loaded to populate cache entries, a visible search was submitted to request a distinct response, or scrolling revealed lazy-loaded resources.
